set -euo pipefail; .venv/bin/python - <<'PY' | tee /tmp/stage27c-dual-ble-hardware-gate-v2.log
import serial
import time

port = '/dev/cu.usbserial-110'
deadline = time.monotonic() + 90.0
print(f'SERIAL_CAPTURE_BEGIN port={port} seconds=90', flush=True)
with serial.Serial(port, 115200, timeout=1.0) as ser:
    while time.monotonic() < deadline:
        raw = ser.readline()
        if raw:
            line = raw.decode('utf-8', errors='replace').rstrip()
            if 'climate_stage27' in line or 'scd41' in line or 'Guru Meditation' in line or 'watchdog' in line.lower() or 'panic' in line.lower():
                print(line, flush=True)
print('SERIAL_CAPTURE_END', flush=True)
PY
.venv/bin/python - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
import re

text = Path('/tmp/stage27c-dual-ble-hardware-gate-v2.log').read_text(errors='replace')
required = [
    'scd41_available=1',
    'scd41_sample=1',
    'rtc_available=1 rtc_trusted=1',
    'ble_scanning=1',
    'tp357_sample=1',
    'xiaomi_sample=1',
    'outputs=fake-locked',
]
for needle in required:
    assert needle in text, f'missing hardware evidence: {needle}'
assert not re.search(r'Guru Meditation|Task watchdog|panic|abort\(\)', text, re.IGNORECASE), 'crash/watchdog evidence present'
pattern = re.compile(
    r'tp357_sample=1 tp357_t=([-+0-9.]+) tp357_rh=([-+0-9.]+) '
    r'tp357_packet_ms=([0-9]+) tp357_valid_ms=([0-9]+) '
    r'xiaomi_sample=1 xiaomi_t=([-+0-9.]+) xiaomi_rh=([-+0-9.]+) '
    r'xiaomi_packet_ms=([0-9]+) xiaomi_valid_ms=([0-9]+)'
)
matches = list(pattern.finditer(text))
assert matches, 'no simultaneous valid TP357 + Xiaomi diagnostic line'
m = matches[-1]
tp_t, tp_rh, tp_packet, tp_valid, xi_t, xi_rh, xi_packet, xi_valid = m.groups()
tp_t = float(tp_t); tp_rh = float(tp_rh); xi_t = float(xi_t); xi_rh = float(xi_rh)
tp_packet = int(tp_packet); tp_valid = int(tp_valid); xi_packet = int(xi_packet); xi_valid = int(xi_valid)
assert -50.0 <= tp_t <= 100.0 and 0.0 <= tp_rh <= 100.0
assert -50.0 <= xi_t <= 100.0 and 0.0 <= xi_rh <= 100.0
assert tp_packet > 0 and tp_valid > 0 and xi_packet > 0 and xi_valid > 0
assert tp_packet >= tp_valid and xi_packet >= xi_valid
print(f'HARDWARE_GATE_PASS tp357_t={tp_t:.2f} tp357_rh={tp_rh:.2f} tp357_packet_ms={tp_packet} tp357_valid_ms={tp_valid} xiaomi_t={xi_t:.2f} xiaomi_rh={xi_rh:.2f} xiaomi_packet_ms={xi_packet} xiaomi_valid_ms={xi_valid}')
PY
test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "a1a05a91a6928f672a8f4f43963f979fefa7d79d" && test -z "$(git status --short)"
